messages:
deploybot: PRE-FLIGHT FAILURE — env-parity-check failed for service=layout-embedder. Prod secret mismatch: EMBED_CONFIG encoding differs (prod: base64-JSON, staging: base64-YAML). Release paused.
kevin: taking this. @tara can you confirm the rotation that landed in staging?
tara: yep, i rotated config and changed export format to YAML for the new parser in staging yesterday. forgot to update prod overlay. staging smoke passed because tests decode YAML.
ops-lead: ugh. how did this not show up earlier? deploybot only checks secret key presence today.
kevin: quick inspect: `kubectl -n inference get secret embed-config -o jsonpath='{.data.config}' | base64 --decode | head -n1` -> prod: `{"version":2,"alias":"embed/v2"}` staging: `version: 3\nalias: embed/v3`. Parser expects YAML v3.
release-eng: options: 1) convert prod secret to YAML v3 (hotpatch), 2) rollback release to legacy parser image, 3) make parser accept both formats (code change, slower). Change window closes in 30m.
tara: converting prod secret is fast but requires KMS write privileges; ops approval needed.
ops-lead: we don't grant ad-hoc KMS writes during change windows unless emergency. This feels risky.
kevin: rollback PR ready to pin image `registry/redwood/layout-embedder:20260316-compat`. I can open and apply in ~10m.
release-eng: ops prefers rollback to minimize blast radius. We'll hold promotion until morning. Leave a follow-up to add a deploybot check to compare secret decoded content, not just keys.
ops-lead: filing mitigation ticket RL-4110 for daily secret parity check and RL-4111 for deploybot value-check enhancement.
tara: noted. i'll coordinate a post-window secret reconciliation and update runbook to include encoding audit when rotating formats.
kevin: applying rollback: `kubectl -n inference set image deploy/layout-embedder layout-embedder=registry/redwood/layout-embedder:20260316-compat`
deploybot: detected image change, running post-deploy health checks.
ops-lead: tailing logs and metrics. smoke looks green, no spike in errors.
release-eng: changelog note: "rollback: pinned layout-embedder due to secret encoding/format drift between staging and prod; follow-up to add parity checks and runbook updates."
kevin: updating release thread + creating a small playbook for secret-encoding rotations.
deploybot: thread closed after rollback success verification.
